heading_en: Specific Risk of Short Positions in Securitization Exposures
summary_ja: 証券化エクスポージャーの個別リスクの計算に第二百七十二条第二項を準用する。
summary_en: Applies Article 272, paragraph (2) mutatis mutandis to the calculation of specific risk of securitization exposures.
paragraphs: The provisions of Article 272, paragraph (2) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the amount of specific risk of securitization exposures.
